summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the disposition of its wholly owned equity interest in Italian Serie B football club S.S. Juve Stabia S.r.l. to Stabia Capital S.r.l. Total cash consideration was €1.00, with the buyer assuming all outstanding debts, obligations, and liabilities. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The transaction was executed via a deed of transfer dated April 17, 2026. No premium, regulatory clock, or break fee was disclosed. Watch for completion of liability assumption and any post-closing adjustments.
